senses.en: a connection between people, things, or ideas
a clickable element that opens another webpage or digital resource
to connect things or show a relationship between them

ex.en: The new bridge provides a link between the villages.
ex.zh: 这座新桥连接了这些村庄。

ex.en: Researchers have identified a strong link between regular physical activity and improved mental health.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现，经常运动与心理健康改善之间存在密切联系。

col: link A to B｜将A与B联系起来
tip: 常用a link between A and B；动词用link A to/with B。

senses.en: the end of a person's or animal's life

ex.en: The old dog's death left the family deeply sad.
ex.zh: 老狗的离世让全家人深感悲伤。

ex.en: Improved access to clean drinking water has reduced deaths from preventable diseases in many communities.
ex.zh: 更便利地获得清洁饮用水，已减少了许多社区中可预防疾病导致的死亡。

tip: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

senses.en: the particular taste of food or drink
to give food or drink a particular taste
a distinctive quality that gives something its character

ex.en: Fresh basil gives this soup a lovely flavour.
ex.zh: 新鲜罗勒让这道汤有了宜人的风味。

ex.en: School cooking lessons can teach children how to improve flavour without adding excessive salt or sugar.
ex.zh: 学校的烹饪课可以教孩子如何在不过量加盐或糖的情况下提升食物风味。

tip: 英式拼写flavour，美式拼写flavor。

senses.en: to move at the same speed, or to continue

ex.en: Run faster or you can't keep up with us!
ex.zh: 跑快点，不然你跟不上我们！

ex.en: She works hard to keep up with her classmates.
ex.zh: 她努力学习以跟上同学。

tip: keep up with 是“跟上（进度/步伐）”。
scene: Two runners on a track, one struggling to keep up with the other.

senses.en: to phone someone, or to total a sale

ex.en: I'll ring up the restaurant to book a table.
ex.zh: 我会打电话给餐厅订位。

ex.en: The cashier rang up the items at the checkout.
ex.zh: 收银员在收银台结算商品。

tip: ring up 表示“打电话”（英式）。
scene: A person calling a restaurant to book a table.

senses.en: To decide that something planned will not happen.
To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.

ex.en: We had to cancel our picnic because of heavy rain.
ex.zh: 由于下大雨，我们不得不取消野餐。

ex.en: Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.
ex.zh: 如果能源效率提高促使人们增加消费，就可能抵消部分环境效益。

tip: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。

senses.en: How good or bad something is.
A characteristic of a person or thing.
Of a high standard.

ex.en: The quality of these shoes surprised me for the price.
ex.zh: 以这个价格来说，这双鞋的质量让我感到惊喜。

ex.en: Governments should improve the quality of public transport before encouraging people to give up driving.
ex.zh: 政府应先提高公共交通的质量，再鼓励人们放弃开车。

tip: 表示质量通常不可数；表示特质时可数。

senses.en: a fish with pink flesh, or its flesh as food
having a pink colour with a slight orange shade

ex.en: We watched a salmon leap up the rocky stream.
ex.zh: 我们看着一条鲑鱼在多石的溪流中跃向上游。

ex.en: Dams can disrupt salmon migration, so river management should consider both energy production and wildlife protection.
ex.zh: 水坝可能阻碍鲑鱼洄游，因此河流管理应兼顾能源生产与野生动物保护。

tip: l不发音；指鱼时单复数同形，指鱼肉时不可数。

senses.en: A large bird often raised for its meat
Meat from a turkey, eaten as food
Something that fails badly, especially a film or play

ex.en: A turkey spread its tail feathers near the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一只火鸡在农场大门旁展开了尾羽。

ex.en: Turkey production provides affordable protein, but intensive farming can raise concerns about animal welfare and environmental damage.
ex.zh: 火鸡养殖提供了价格实惠的蛋白质，但集约化养殖可能引发对动物福利和环境破坏的担忧。

tip: 鸟可数，肉不可数；表示失败之作时属非正式用法。

senses.en: the outer form of something
to influence how something develops
to give something a particular physical form

ex.en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
ex.zh: 她把饼干坯切成了星星的形状。

ex.en: Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.
ex.zh: 幼年经历可以塑造学习态度，并影响未来的学业成就。

col: stay in shape｜保持良好的身体状态
tip: in shape可指身体状态好，不只表示形状。

senses.en: Not known, identified, or familiar.
Something not yet understood, or a person not widely known.

ex.en: An unknown caller rang while I was cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我做晚饭时，一个陌生人打来了电话。

ex.en: The long-term effects of some new materials remain unknown, so further research is essential before widespread use.
ex.zh: 某些新材料的长期影响仍不明确，因此在广泛使用前必须进一步研究。

col: unknown to someone｜某人不知道的
tip: the unknown泛指“未知事物或未知领域”。

senses.en: a pronunciation style associated with a place or social group
emphasis on a syllable, or a mark indicating pronunciation
to give special emphasis or prominence to something

ex.en: Her accent reminds me of my neighbours back home.
ex.zh: 她的口音让我想起家乡的邻居。

ex.en: Teachers should value different accents while helping learners develop clear pronunciation for effective international communication.
ex.zh: 教师应尊重不同口音，同时帮助学习者练就清晰的发音，以便有效开展国际交流。

col: speak with an accent｜说话带口音
tip: accent指发音特点；dialect还涉及词汇和语法。

senses.en: Responsible for breaking a law or doing something wrong.
Feeling bad because you believe you have done something wrong.

ex.en: I felt guilty about forgetting my sister's birthday.
ex.zh: 我忘了姐姐的生日，感到很内疚。

ex.en: Companies found guilty of illegally dumping waste should face penalties that reflect the environmental damage caused.
ex.zh: 被裁定非法倾倒废物的公司应受到与其造成的环境损害相称的处罚。

col: find someone guilty｜裁定某人有罪
tip: guilty of接罪行；feel guilty about接内疚的事。

senses.en: A son of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.

ex.en: My nephew proudly showed me his new bicycle.
ex.zh: 我的侄子自豪地给我看他的新自行车。

ex.en: Looking after a nephew or niece can help young adults understand the responsibilities of raising children.
ex.zh: 照顾侄子或侄女可以帮助年轻人理解养育孩子的责任。

col: young nephew｜年幼的侄子或外甥
tip: nephew 指男性晚辈；女性对应词是 niece。

senses.en: To use physical force against another person or group.
To try hard to stop something or achieve a goal.
An occasion of physical conflict or a determined effort against something.

ex.en: The two cats fought over a sunny window seat.
ex.zh: 两只猫为了窗边一个有阳光的位置打了起来。

ex.en: Governments should fight poverty by improving access to education, healthcare, and stable employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 政府应通过改善教育和医疗服务的可及性、增加稳定就业机会来消除贫困。

col: get into a fight｜卷入打斗
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为fought；fight for表示争取。

senses.en: To a very great degree.

ex.en: The soup was extremely hot, so I waited.
ex.zh: 汤烫极了，所以我等了一会儿。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet is extremely important for students who depend on online learning.
ex.zh: 对于依赖在线学习的学生来说，能够使用可靠的网络极其重要。

tip: 修饰可分程度的形容词或副词，语气强于very。

senses.en: to give something to a teacher or official

ex.en: Please hand in your homework before Friday.
ex.zh: 请在周五前交作业。

ex.en: She handed in her resignation yesterday.
ex.zh: 她昨天递交了辞职信。

tip: hand in 是“上交”；give in 也含此义。
scene: A student handing a paper to a teacher at a desk.

senses.en: A person or organisation trying to succeed against others.
Someone taking part in a competition.

ex.en: The new bakery is our biggest competitor for local customers.
ex.zh: 那家新面包店是我们争取本地顾客时最大的竞争对手。

ex.en: A business must understand its competitors before developing strategies to attract customers in an increasingly crowded market.
ex.zh: 企业必须了解竞争对手，才能制定策略，在日益拥挤的市场中吸引顾客。

col: a major competitor｜主要竞争对手
a direct competitor｜直接竞争对手
a strong competitor｜强劲的竞争者
tip: competitor指竞争者；competition指竞争或比赛。

senses.en: take air into your lungs and let it out

ex.en: Sit by the window and breathe slowly for a minute.
ex.zh: 坐在窗边，缓缓呼吸一分钟。

ex.en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人经常吸入受污染的空气，这可能增加他们患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

col: breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

senses.en: To say what will happen, often using evidence.

ex.en: They predict heavy rain, so take your umbrella.
ex.zh: 他们预报有大雨，所以带上你的伞吧。

ex.en: Climate models help scientists predict how rising temperatures may affect agricultural production in different regions.
ex.zh: 气候模型帮助科学家预测气温上升可能如何影响不同地区的农业生产。

tip: 可接that从句；不要与表示预防的prevent混淆。

senses.en: to keep someone interested or amused
to welcome guests and provide food, drink, or activities
to consider an idea or hold a thought or feeling

ex.en: My brother entertained the children with funny animal noises.
ex.zh: 我哥哥模仿动物发出滑稽的叫声，逗孩子们开心。

ex.en: Public museums should educate visitors as well as entertain them through engaging displays and interactive activities.
ex.zh: 公共博物馆应通过引人入胜的展览和互动活动，让参观者既获得知识又享受乐趣。

col: entertain an audience｜为观众提供娱乐
entertain the idea of｜考虑……的想法
tip: entertain an idea指考虑某想法，并非已经接受。

senses.en: a vegetable with leaves often eaten raw in salads

ex.en: Wash the lettuce before adding it to your sandwich.
ex.zh: 把生菜洗净后再夹进三明治里。

ex.en: Growing lettuce in urban gardens can give residents access to fresh food near their homes.
ex.zh: 在城市菜园种植生菜能让居民在家附近获得新鲜食材。

col: a head of lettuce｜一棵生菜
tip: 指食材通常不可数；一棵生菜用a head of lettuce。

senses.en: Requiring customers to serve themselves rather than wait for staff
A system in which customers serve themselves

ex.en: We carried our trays through the self-service cafeteria.
ex.zh: 我们端着托盘穿过了自助餐厅。

ex.en: Although self-service machines can shorten queues, businesses should retain staff to assist customers who need additional support.
ex.zh: 虽然自助机器能缩短队伍，但企业仍应保留员工，为需要额外帮助的顾客提供服务。

tip: self-service强调顾客自己操作，不等于机器全自动。

senses.en: Unpleasant to look at.
Unpleasant or threatening, especially involving anger or conflict.

ex.en: We hid the ugly pipes behind a wooden screen.
ex.zh: 我们用木制屏风遮住了那些难看的管道。

ex.en: Poorly planned developments can create ugly urban landscapes that reduce residents' satisfaction with their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 规划不善的开发项目可能形成难看的城市景观，降低居民对社区的满意度。

tip: 比较级uglier，最高级ugliest；形容人外貌不礼貌。

senses.en: Telling the truth and not cheating or stealing.
Expressing what you really think or feel.

ex.en: The honest cashier returned the money I had overpaid.
ex.zh: 那位诚实的收银员退还了我多付的钱。

ex.en: Honest communication between teachers and parents can help schools address students' difficulties before they become serious.
ex.zh: 教师与家长之间坦诚的沟通能帮助学校在学生的问题变得严重之前加以解决。

tip: h不发音，因此说an honest person。

senses.en: Harm that makes something less useful, valuable, or healthy.
Harm something or make it less effective.

ex.en: The storm caused serious damage to our garden shed.
ex.zh: 暴风雨严重损坏了我们花园里的棚屋。

ex.en: Uncontrolled tourism can damage fragile ecosystems and reduce the quality of life for local residents.
ex.zh: 不受控制的旅游活动可能破坏脆弱的生态系统，并降低当地居民的生活质量。

col: damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
tip: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。

senses.en: A length of time or a stage in history.
A scheduled length of time for a school lesson.
The monthly flow of blood from the uterus.

ex.en: We stayed indoors during a short period of heavy rain.
ex.zh: 在那阵短暂的大雨期间，我们一直待在室内。

ex.en: A prolonged period of unemployment can affect both financial security and mental health.
ex.zh: 长期失业既会影响经济保障，也会影响心理健康。

col: a period of time｜一段时间
tip: 表示一段时间常用a period of；美式英语也指句号。

senses.en: to take someone into police custody under legal authority
the act of taking someone into police custody
to stop the progress or development of something

ex.en: Police arrested the suspect outside the station yesterday.
ex.zh: 警方昨天在车站外逮捕了嫌疑人。

ex.en: Early investment in building maintenance can arrest the decline of historic neighbourhoods and preserve their distinctive character.
ex.zh: 尽早投入建筑维护资金可以遏制历史街区的衰落，并保留其独特风貌。

col: arrest someone for theft｜因盗窃逮捕某人
tip: 因某事被捕用be arrested for；under arrest表示被捕状态。

senses.en: funny or entertaining in a pleasant way

ex.en: My cousin told an amusing story about his cat.
ex.zh: 我表哥讲了一个关于他家猫的趣事。

ex.en: Teachers can use amusing examples to maintain students' attention while explaining difficult concepts in science lessons.
ex.zh: 教师可以在科学课上用有趣的例子吸引学生注意，同时解释难懂的概念。

col: find something amusing｜觉得某事好笑
tip: amusing形容事物逗人笑；amused形容人觉得好笑。

senses.en: burning

ex.en: The kitchen was on fire, so we called 119.
ex.zh: 厨房着火了，我们拨了119。

ex.en: The old barn caught on fire last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚旧谷仓着火了。

tip: catch fire 是“着火”；be on fire 是“正在燃烧”。
scene: Flames rising from a building with a fire engine arriving.

senses.en: Feeling thankful for kindness, help, or something good.

ex.en: I am grateful for your help with the move.
ex.zh: 谢谢你帮我搬家。

ex.en: Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.
ex.zh: 许多学生感谢奖学金让他们即使经济困难也能继续学业。

tip: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。

senses.en: The appearance of the sun above the horizon each morning.

ex.en: We woke early to watch the sunrise over the lake.
ex.zh: 我们早早醒来，观看湖上的日出。

ex.en: Outdoor activities scheduled around sunrise allow tourists to enjoy cooler temperatures and observe local wildlife.
ex.zh: 安排在日出前后的户外活动让游客能在较凉爽的气温下观赏当地野生动物。

tip: 在日出时用at sunrise；日落是sunset。

senses.en: Rest with your body or an object in a flat position
Say something you know is not true
Something untrue that someone says deliberately

ex.en: I like to lie on the grass after lunch.
ex.zh: 我喜欢午饭后躺在草地上。

ex.en: Advertisements that lie about environmental benefits can undermine public trust and discourage genuinely sustainable purchasing decisions.
ex.zh: 就环保效益撒谎的广告会损害公众信任，并阻碍真正可持续的购买决策。

tip: 躺：lie–lay–lain；说谎：lie–lied–lied。

senses.en: a tall, narrow structure, standing alone or on a building
rise much higher than nearby people or things

ex.en: We climbed the tower and watched boats cross the bay.
ex.zh: 我们爬上塔，看着船只驶过海湾。

ex.en: The historic tower attracts visitors throughout the year, providing valuable income for nearby shops and restaurants.
ex.zh: 这座历史悠久的塔全年吸引着游客，为附近的商店和餐馆带来可观收入。

tip: 作动词常接over或above，表示远高于周围事物。

senses.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought.

ex.en: It was stupid to leave my umbrella at home.
ex.zh: 把伞留在家里真是太傻了。

ex.en: Calling students stupid can damage their confidence and discourage them from asking questions in class.
ex.zh: 说学生愚蠢会损害他们的信心，使他们不敢在课堂上提问。

tip: 直接说别人stupid带侮辱性，评价人时应避免。

senses.en: a person who rides a bicycle

ex.en: The cyclist stopped beside the bridge for water.
ex.zh: 那位骑自行车的人在桥边停下来喝水。

ex.en: Protected cycle lanes can reduce the risk of collisions between cyclists and motor vehicles in busy cities.
ex.zh: 在繁忙的城市中，有隔离设施的自行车道可以降低骑车者与机动车碰撞的风险。

col: professional cyclist｜职业自行车运动员
tip: cyclist指骑自行车的人，不指骑摩托车的人。

senses.en: the job of making clothes smooth with an iron

ex.en: The ironing takes about half an hour.
ex.zh: 熨衣服大约需要半小时。

ex.en: She does the ironing on Sunday evenings.
ex.zh: 她周日晚熨衣服。

tip: do the ironing 是“熨衣服”；iron 是熨斗/熨烫。
scene: A person ironing a shirt on an ironing board in a room.

senses.en: The feeling of being pleased or satisfied with life.

ex.en: Her face shone with happiness when the puppy arrived.
ex.zh: 小狗到来时，她的脸上洋溢着喜悦。

ex.en: Strong social connections often contribute more to lasting happiness than the purchase of expensive possessions.
ex.zh: 与购买昂贵物品相比，牢固的社会联系往往更能带来持久的幸福。

tip: 通常不可数：表达幸福用happiness，不加a。

senses.en: return to health or a normal condition after difficulty
get back something lost, stolen, or spent

ex.en: It took several days to recover from the flu.
ex.zh: 流感过后，花了好几天才康复。

ex.en: Local economies often recover more quickly when governments provide timely support for small businesses.
ex.zh: 政府及时为小企业提供支持时，当地经济往往恢复得更快。

col: recover from an illness｜病后康复
recover lost data｜恢复丢失的数据
tip: 从疾病或挫折中恢复用recover from。

senses.en: A brass musical instrument with three valves and a bright sound.
To announce or praise something loudly and publicly.
To make a loud sound like an elephant's call.

ex.en: The musician lifted her trumpet and played a cheerful tune.
ex.zh: 那位乐手举起小号，吹奏了一支欢快的曲子。

ex.en: Learning the trumpet in a school orchestra can improve students' concentration and ability to cooperate with others.
ex.zh: 在学校管弦乐队学习小号可以提升学生的专注力及与他人合作的能力。

tip: 乐器义是“小号”；动词可指大肆宣扬。

senses.en: The main page of a website, linking to other sections.

ex.en: The library's homepage has a photo of its new reading room.
ex.zh: 图书馆主页上有一张新阅览室的照片。

ex.en: A university homepage should provide clear access to course information, application guidance, and support services for international students.
ex.zh: 大学主页应提供清晰的入口，方便国际学生查看课程信息、申请指南及支持服务。

tip: 也可写作home page；不等于网站中的任意网页。

senses.en: For every hundred, used when expressing a proportion.

ex.en: I saved twenty percent on my new winter coat.
ex.zh: 我买新冬衣时省了百分之二十的钱。

ex.en: Nearly forty percent of surveyed residents supported investing more public money in cycling infrastructure.
ex.zh: 近百分之四十的受访居民支持将更多公共资金投入自行车基础设施。

col: a five percent increase｜百分之五的增长
tip: 英式也写per cent；具体比例用percent。

senses.en: A person or organisation that something belongs to.

ex.en: The owner of the bakery greets us every morning.
ex.zh: 面包店老板每天早上都向我们打招呼。

ex.en: Property owners should maintain their buildings to ensure the safety of tenants and nearby residents.
ex.zh: 房产业主应维护其建筑，确保租户和附近居民的安全。

tip: 表示某物的所有者，用the owner of加名词。

senses.en: To pull something apart or make a hole by pulling.
A drop of liquid that comes from your eye.
A hole or split caused by pulling something apart.

ex.en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
ex.zh: 小心别把纸袋撕破了。

ex.en: Thin plastic bags tear easily, making them less suitable for repeated use than durable cloth alternatives.
ex.zh: 薄塑料袋容易撕裂，因此不如耐用的布袋适合反复使用。

tip: 撕裂读/teə/，眼泪读/tɪə/；动词变化为 tore、torn。

senses.en: Lasting a short time or using few words.
To give someone essential information or instructions.
Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.

ex.en: We took a brief break before finishing the puzzle.
ex.zh: 我们短暂休息了一下，然后完成了拼图。

ex.en: Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.
ex.zh: 教师应先向学生介绍安全操作规程，再允许他们独立进行实验。

col: brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况
a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

senses.en: a design or symbol that represents an organisation or product

ex.en: The bakery uses a wheat stalk as its logo.
ex.zh: 这家面包店用一支麦穗作为徽标。

ex.en: A distinctive logo helps consumers recognise a company, but product quality is essential for building lasting trust.
ex.zh: 独特的徽标帮助消费者识别企业，但产品质量才是建立持久信任的关键。

tip: logo指视觉标识；slogan指宣传口号。

senses.en: money borrowed and expected to be paid back
the temporary use of something belonging to someone else
to give money or something temporarily, expecting its return

ex.en: We took out a loan to repair the roof.
ex.zh: 我们申请了一笔贷款来修屋顶。

ex.en: Affordable student loans can widen access to university, although repayment may create financial pressure after graduation.
ex.zh: 负担得起的学生贷款可以扩大大学入学机会，但毕业后的还款可能带来经济压力。

col: take out a loan｜申请贷款
tip: loan作动词意为借出，不是借入。

senses.en: not allowed by a rule, law, or authority

ex.en: Taking photos is forbidden inside this small museum.
ex.zh: 这家小博物馆内禁止拍照。

ex.en: In many protected areas, hunting is strictly forbidden to preserve wildlife populations and maintain ecological balance.
ex.zh: 在许多保护区，狩猎被严格禁止，以保护野生动物种群并维持生态平衡。

tip: 也是forbid的过去分词；过去式为forbade。

senses.en: Something wrong with an object, system, or person's character
Responsibility for a mistake or something bad that happened
A break in rock where sections have moved apart

ex.en: A small electrical fault stopped the washing machine yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天一个小小的电路故障让洗衣机停止了运转。

ex.en: Regular inspections can identify a structural fault before it threatens the safety of residents.
ex.zh: 定期检查能在结构缺陷危及居民安全之前发现它。

tip: It's my fault表示“是我的错”，不用mistake替换。

senses.en: to make a phone call by dialling

ex.en: In the past, computers used dial-up to go online.
ex.zh: 过去电脑用拨号上网。

ex.en: She dialled up her friend's number.
ex.zh: 她拨了朋友的号码。

tip: dial up 原指“拨号上网/打电话”，现在主要说 dial。
scene: An old computer with a dial-up modem making a connection sound.

senses.en: an object wrapped for sending by post or delivery
a piece of land considered as a single unit
to wrap something, or divide it into portions for distribution

ex.en: A small parcel arrived for you this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上有个寄给你的小包裹到了。

ex.en: The growing volume of parcel deliveries has encouraged cities to explore cleaner transport options for local distribution.
ex.zh: 包裹配送量不断增长，促使城市探索更环保的本地配送方式。

col: a parcel of land｜一块土地
tip: 包裹在英式英语中常用parcel，美式英语更常用package。

senses.en: a group of words expressing an idea or forming a unit
to express something using particular words

ex.en: I learned a useful phrase in my English class today.
ex.zh: 今天我在英语课上学到了一个实用短语。

ex.en: Researchers must phrase survey questions carefully to avoid influencing participants and reducing the reliability of their findings.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须仔细斟酌调查问题的措辞，以免影响参与者并降低研究结果的可靠性。

tip: phrase是短语，不一定构成完整句子。

senses.en: Relating to one person or thing rather than a group
One person or living thing considered separately from others
Having qualities that make someone or something different from others

ex.en: The teacher gave each child an individual box of crayons.
ex.zh: 老师给每个孩子单独发了一盒彩色蜡笔。

ex.en: Education systems should recognise individual learning needs rather than expect every student to progress at the same pace.
ex.zh: 教育体系应重视个人的学习需求，而不是指望每个学生都以相同的速度进步。

tip: 形容词强调单个或个人；作可数名词指一个人或个体。

senses.en: completely; in every way or to the fullest degree

ex.en: I totally forgot to bring my swimming costume.
ex.zh: 我完全忘了带泳衣。

ex.en: Online courses cannot totally replace classroom teaching because students also benefit from direct social interaction.
ex.zh: 在线课程无法完全取代课堂教学，因为学生也能从直接的社交互动中受益。

tip: 语气较强；正式写作中常可换用completely或entirely。

senses.en: Put something where people can see it
An arrangement of things for people to look at
A screen that shows information or images

ex.en: The bakery displays fresh cakes beside the front window.
ex.zh: 面包店把新鲜蛋糕陈列在前窗旁。

ex.en: Museums increasingly display everyday objects to illustrate how ordinary people lived in the past.
ex.zh: 博物馆越来越多地展示日常物品，以呈现过去普通人的生活方式。

col: a colourful display｜色彩缤纷的陈列
tip: on display意为“在展出”，中间不加冠词。

senses.en: A feeling of happiness or enjoyment
An activity or experience that brings enjoyment

ex.en: She takes great pleasure in growing herbs on her balcony.
ex.zh: 她在阳台上种香草，从中获得很大的乐趣。

ex.en: Public libraries encourage reading for pleasure while providing affordable access to knowledge for people of all ages.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆鼓励以阅读为乐，同时让各年龄段的人都能以低廉的成本获取知识。

col: take pleasure in｜从……中获得乐趣
tip: 快乐通常不可数；一件乐事可说a pleasure。

senses.en: After a short amount of time.
In a brief, unfriendly or impatient way.

ex.en: The bus will arrive shortly, so get your bag ready.
ex.zh: 公交车马上就到，把你的包准备好。

ex.en: Shortly after the new railway opened, local businesses reported a significant increase in customer visits.
ex.zh: 新铁路开通后不久，当地商家就报告称到店顾客显著增加。

tip: 表示“简要地”通常用briefly，不用shortly。

senses.en: a person who serves in an army

ex.en: The soldier helped carry supplies across the flooded road.
ex.zh: 那名士兵帮忙把物资运过被洪水淹没的道路。

ex.en: Soldiers can support emergency services by delivering food and rescuing residents after major natural disasters.
ex.zh: 重大自然灾害发生后，军人可以通过运送食物和救助居民来支援应急部门。

col: serve as a soldier｜当兵服役
tip: 通常指陆军军人；水手和飞行员另有专称。

senses.en: improvement or movement towards a goal
to improve or move towards a more advanced stage

ex.en: You have made real progress with your swimming.
ex.zh: 你的游泳水平确实有了进步。

ex.en: Regular feedback helps students monitor their progress and identify areas that require further practice.
ex.zh: 定期反馈有助于学生了解自己的进步，并找出需要进一步练习的方面。

tip: 名词不可数；动词重音后移，英音/prəˈɡres/。

senses.en: a small, flat, crisp baked food, often sweet
a small, soft bread roll raised without yeast

ex.en: She dipped a biscuit into her warm tea.
ex.zh: 她把一块饼干浸进温热的茶里。

ex.en: Replacing sugary biscuits with fresh fruit can help children develop healthier eating habits over time.
ex.zh: 用新鲜水果代替高糖饼干，可以帮助儿童逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干
tip: 英式biscuit通常对应美式cookie；美式另指松软面包。

senses.en: The process of officially recording details or joining something.
An official document showing that something has been registered.

ex.en: Registration for the swimming course opens on Monday.
ex.zh: 游泳课程将于周一开始报名。

ex.en: Online registration can improve access to public services, provided that support remains available for people without internet access.
ex.zh: 网上登记可以让公共服务更易获取，前提是仍为无法上网的人提供帮助。

tip: 表示报名或注册某活动，常用registration for。

senses.en: led or supported by someone with knowledge or experience

ex.en: We joined a guided walk through the forest yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们参加了一次有向导带领的森林徒步。

ex.en: Guided learning can help students build confidence before they begin working independently on complex tasks.
ex.zh: 有指导的学习可以帮助学生建立信心，为独立完成复杂任务做好准备。

tip: guided tour指有导游的游览；guided也是guide的过去分词。

senses.zh: 令人恶心的；令人反感的
senses.en: extremely unpleasant, making you feel sick or strongly dislike something

senses.zh: 令人愤慨的；不可接受的
senses.en: so bad or wrong that it causes strong disapproval

ex.en: A disgusting smell came from the forgotten rubbish bag.
ex.zh: 那个被遗忘的垃圾袋散发出一股令人恶心的气味。

ex.en: Residents described the illegal dumping of waste beside their homes as disgusting and demanded immediate action.
ex.zh: 居民称在住宅旁非法倾倒垃圾的行为令人愤慨，并要求立即采取行动。

col: a disgusting smell｜令人恶心的气味
tip: disgusting形容事物令人反感；disgusted形容人感到反感。

senses.en: a cloth used to cover a table

ex.en: She spread a white table-cloth for dinner.
ex.zh: 她铺了一块白桌布准备吃晚饭。

ex.en: The table-cloth has a red pattern.
ex.zh: 这块桌布有红色图案。

tip: table-cloth 是桌布；也拼作 tablecloth。
scene: A dining table covered with a white table-cloth and plates.

senses.en: Every time that something happens.
At any time that something happens or is convenient.
Used in questions to express surprise about when something happened.

ex.en: Whenever I cook soup, my cat waits beside the stove.
ex.zh: 每当我煮汤时，我的猫就守在炉子旁边。

ex.en: Whenever cities expand, planners should consider how new developments will affect existing communities and local wildlife.
ex.zh: 每当城市扩张时，规划者都应考虑新开发项目将如何影响现有社区和当地野生动物。

col: whenever you like｜随你什么时候
tip: 引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时，不用will。

senses.en: Arrange to keep something for a particular person or purpose.
A supply kept for use when needed.
An area where wildlife and natural habitats are protected.

ex.en: Could you reserve a table for us tonight?
ex.zh: 你能帮我们预订今晚的餐桌吗？

ex.en: Governments should maintain adequate food reserves to protect vulnerable communities during periods of severe drought.
ex.zh: 政府应保持充足的粮食储备，以便在严重干旱期间保护脆弱群体。

col: reserve something for someone｜为某人保留某物
tip: 动词常用 reserve sth for sb；储量常用 reserves。

senses.en: difficult to understand

ex.en: The instructions were confusing, so I asked for help.
ex.zh: 说明令人困惑，所以我求助了。

ex.en: The map is confusing; we took the wrong road.
ex.zh: 这张地图让人看不懂，我们走错路了。

tip: confusing 形容事物“令人困惑”；confused 形容人“感到困惑”。
scene: A puzzled driver looking at a complicated road map.

senses.en: the final part of a story, event, or activity
a final word part that often shows grammatical information

ex.en: The film had a surprisingly cheerful ending for everyone.
ex.zh: 这部电影的结局出人意料，所有人都皆大欢喜。

ex.en: An ambiguous ending can encourage readers to question their assumptions and consider alternative interpretations of a novel.
ex.zh: 含义不明确的结局可以促使读者质疑自己的假设，并考虑对小说的其他解读。

col: a surprise ending｜出人意料的结局
tip: 故事结局用ending；at the end表示在末尾。

senses.en: to help, encourage, provide for, or agree with someone
to hold something up or bear its weight
help, encouragement, money, or something that holds another thing up

ex.en: My sister supports me whenever I try something new.
ex.zh: 每当我尝试新事物时，姐姐都会支持我。

ex.en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。

col: support an argument｜为论点提供依据
tip: support是及物动词；名词常用support for。

senses.en: An area of ground used for outdoor team sports.
How high or low a sound is.
Present an idea or product to persuade someone to accept it.

ex.en: The players ran onto the pitch despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，球员们还是跑进了球场。

ex.en: Young entrepreneurs often pitch their business ideas to investors who can provide funding and practical guidance.
ex.zh: 年轻创业者经常向能够提供资金和实用指导的投资者推介商业构想。

tip: 球场义常见于英式英语；pitch a tent意为搭帐篷。

senses.en: a polite word for an adult woman

ex.en: A kind lady helped me find the station.
ex.zh: 一位好心的女士帮我找到了车站。

ex.en: An elderly lady at the meeting explained how the new bus route had improved her daily life.
ex.zh: 会上，一位年长女士讲述了新公交线路如何改善她的日常生活。

col: an elderly lady｜一位年长女士
a young lady｜一位年轻女士
ladies and gentlemen｜女士们、先生们
tip: woman是中性通用词；lady常用于礼貌称呼。

senses.en: not neat or well arranged
not keeping your belongings or surroundings neat

ex.en: Her untidy desk was covered with cups and notebooks.
ex.zh: 她凌乱的书桌上堆满了杯子和笔记本。

ex.en: Shared workspaces can quickly become untidy unless employees take responsibility for keeping communal areas clean and organised.
ex.zh: 如果员工不主动保持公共区域干净有序，共享办公空间很快就会变得凌乱。

tip: untidy强调不整齐，不一定像dirty那样有污垢。

senses.en: to cause a change in someone or something
to cause someone to feel a strong emotion

ex.en: Too much coffee can affect how well you sleep.
ex.zh: 喝太多咖啡会影响你的睡眠质量。

ex.en: Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响尤为严重，因为必需品支出占其收入的比例更大。

col: deeply affect someone｜深深触动某人
tip: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

senses.en: Involving fewer hours than a full working or studying week.
For fewer hours than a full working or studying week.

ex.en: My sister has a part-time job at a bakery.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在一家面包店做兼职。

ex.en: Part-time employment allows university students to gain practical experience while continuing to focus on their studies.
ex.zh: 兼职工作让大学生能够在继续专注学业的同时积累实践经验。

col: a part-time job｜一份兼职工作
a part-time course｜非全日制课程
tip: 可作形容词或副词：a part-time job；work part-time。

senses.en: The main church of a district led by a bishop.

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the cathedral's beautiful stained glass windows.
ex.zh: 阳光透过大教堂美丽的彩色玻璃窗洒了进来。

ex.en: Restoring a historic cathedral can preserve traditional craftsmanship while attracting visitors who support the local economy.
ex.zh: 修复历史悠久的大教堂既能保护传统工艺，也能吸引游客，支持当地经济。

tip: 严格指主教驻地的教堂，并非所有大型教堂。

senses.en: Something that makes success more likely than for others.
A useful or positive feature of something.

ex.en: Your long arms give you an advantage in swimming.
ex.zh: 你的长手臂让你在游泳时更有优势。

ex.en: One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.
ex.zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能够缓解城市地区的交通拥堵。

col: have an advantage over｜比……有优势
tip: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

senses.en: Causing discomfort, dislike, or unhappiness.
Behaving in an unfriendly or rude way.

ex.en: An unpleasant smell was coming from the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。

ex.en: Although commuting can be unpleasant, reliable public transport can reduce stress and improve the daily experience of workers.
ex.zh: 虽然通勤可能令人不快，但可靠的公共交通能减轻压力，改善上班族的日常体验。

col: an unpleasant experience｜不愉快的经历
unpleasant side effects｜令人难受的副作用
unpleasant to someone｜对某人不友善
tip: 形容事物表示令人不快；形容人常指态度不友善。

senses.en: sound or moving images saved for later listening or viewing
the process of saving sounds, images, or information

ex.en: We listened to a recording of birds during breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐时，我们听了一段鸟鸣录音。

ex.en: Access to a lecture recording allows students to review difficult concepts at their own pace.
ex.zh: 能够获取讲座录像，让学生可以按自己的节奏复习难懂的概念。

tip: 一段录音可数；表示录制过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: Nervous and unable to relax, or stretched tightly.
A verb form that indicates time.
To tighten muscles or become physically stiff.

ex.en: She looked tense while waiting outside the interview room.
ex.zh: 她在面试室外等候时显得很紧张。

ex.en: A tense working environment can reduce productivity and discourage employees from sharing creative ideas.
ex.zh: 紧张的工作环境可能降低生产效率，并使员工不愿分享创新想法。

tip: 作名词指语法“时态”；作形容词指紧张或绷紧。

senses.en: Someone who teaches a particular skill or activity.
A teacher at an American college or university.

ex.en: Our swimming instructor showed us how to breathe properly.
ex.zh: 我们的游泳教练教我们如何正确呼吸。

ex.en: A qualified instructor can help older adults exercise safely and develop confidence in their physical abilities.
ex.zh: 合格的教练能帮助老年人安全锻炼，并增强他们对自身体能的信心。

tip: 常指教授驾驶、游泳等具体技能的人。

senses.en: something carried, or the amount a vehicle or person carries
to put goods into something or data into computer memory
the amount of work or responsibility someone must manage

ex.en: The donkey carried a heavy load up the hill.
ex.zh: 那头驴驮着沉重的货物上山。

ex.en: Sharing household tasks more equally can reduce the load on parents who also work full time.
ex.zh: 更公平地分担家务可以减轻还需全职工作的父母的负担。

col: a load of laundry｜一批待洗衣物
tip: load A with B指把B装进A；卸货用unload。

senses.en: a picture made using a camera
to take a picture of someone or something using a camera

ex.en: This photograph shows my grandparents standing beside their first house.
ex.zh: 这张照片里，我的祖父母站在他们的第一所房子旁。

ex.en: Historical photographs provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
ex.zh: 历史照片为城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵的证据。

tip: 拍照用take a photograph，不用make。

senses.en: to produce books or other writing for public reading
to make information officially available to the public

ex.en: The local magazine published my photograph of the river.
ex.zh: 当地杂志刊登了我拍摄的河流照片。

ex.en: Researchers should publish their findings openly so that policymakers can make decisions based on reliable evidence.
ex.zh: 研究人员应公开发表研究结果，让政策制定者能够依据可靠证据作出决策。

tip: publish强调向公众发行或公布，不等于仅仅印刷。

senses.en: a process of investigating facts or seeking knowledge
a request for information about something

ex.en: My inquiry about the missing parcel received a quick reply.
ex.zh: 我询问了丢失包裹的情况，很快就收到了回复。

ex.en: An independent inquiry into river pollution revealed serious weaknesses in the current system of environmental monitoring.
ex.zh: 一项针对河流污染的独立调查揭示了现行环境监测体系的严重缺陷。

tip: 调查某事用inquiry into；英式enquiry也常指咨询。

senses.en: A light shoe with straps that leaves much of the foot uncovered.

ex.en: A small stone got stuck inside my sandal.
ex.zh: 一颗小石子卡进了我的凉鞋里。

ex.en: In warm climates, sandals are popular because their open design allows air to circulate around the feet.
ex.zh: 在气候温暖的地区，凉鞋很受欢迎，因为其开放式设计能让脚部通风。

col: a pair of sandals｜一双凉鞋
tip: 单只用sandal，一双用a pair of sandals。

senses.en: a desire to learn about or become involved in something
money paid for borrowing money or earned on savings
to make someone want to know or learn more

ex.en: My interest in cooking began in my grandmother's kitchen.
ex.zh: 我对烹饪的兴趣始于祖母的厨房。

ex.en: Schools can stimulate interest in science by giving students opportunities to conduct experiments and explore practical problems.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生有机会进行实验并探索实际问题，从而激发他们对科学的兴趣。

col: take an interest in｜对……产生兴趣
tip: 兴趣用interest in；具体爱好可用复数interests。

senses.en: land used for farming

ex.en: The village is surrounded by green farmland.
ex.zh: 村庄被绿色的农田环绕。

ex.en: Farmland stretches to the hills in the distance.
ex.zh: 农田一直延伸到远处的山丘。

tip: farmland 是耕地/农田。
scene: Green fields of crops stretching to distant hills with a farmhouse.

senses.en: Ask someone to pay a particular amount for something.
An amount of money requested for goods or services.
Put electrical energy into a battery or device.

ex.en: They charge extra if you want breakfast in your room.
ex.zh: 如果你想在房间里吃早餐，他们会额外收费。

ex.en: Museums that charge admission fees should offer discounts to ensure that students can still access cultural resources.
ex.zh: 收取门票的博物馆应提供优惠，以确保学生仍能享用文化资源。

tip: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。

senses.en: A high, very steep rock face, often beside the sea.

ex.en: We watched seabirds nesting halfway up the cliff.
ex.zh: 我们看着海鸟在悬崖半腰筑巢。

ex.en: Coastal erosion can weaken a cliff over time, putting nearby homes and walking routes at risk.
ex.zh: 海岸侵蚀会逐渐削弱悬崖的稳定性，危及附近的住宅和步行路线。

tip: cliff强调陡峭岩壁，不泛指山坡。

senses.en: An official office representing a country in another country.

ex.en: I contacted the embassy after losing my passport abroad.
ex.zh: 在国外丢失护照后，我联系了大使馆。

ex.en: An embassy provides assistance to citizens overseas and helps maintain diplomatic relations between the two countries.
ex.zh: 大使馆为海外公民提供援助，并帮助维持两国间的外交关系。

tip: embassy指大使馆；consulate指领事馆。

senses.en: Waste left scattered in public places.
To leave rubbish or other objects scattered across a place.
A group of young animals born to one mother together.

ex.en: We picked up litter along the beach before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前，我们沿着海滩捡垃圾。

ex.en: Reducing litter in urban parks requires convenient bins as well as sustained public education campaigns.
ex.zh: 减少城市公园里乱扔的垃圾，需要设置便于使用的垃圾桶，并持续开展公众教育活动。

col: a litter of puppies｜一窝小狗
tip: 垃圾义不可数；一窝幼崽用a litter of。

senses.en: Happening repeatedly, often with similar gaps between events.
Having an even shape, pattern, or arrangement.
Someone who often visits the same place.

ex.en: Our dog needs regular walks to stay happy and healthy.
ex.zh: 我们的狗需要经常散步，才能保持快乐和健康。

ex.en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of chronic disease and improve overall wellbeing in older adults.
ex.zh: 规律运动可以降低老年人患慢性病的风险，并改善其整体身心健康。

col: at regular intervals｜每隔固定时间
tip: regular侧重规律或经常，不等于持续不停的continuous。

senses.en: relating to a group's customs, beliefs, and way of life
relating to activities such as music, literature, and theatre

ex.en: The festival celebrates the town's rich cultural traditions.
ex.zh: 这个节日颂扬小镇丰富的文化传统。

ex.en: Schools can promote cultural understanding by encouraging students to share their family traditions and experiences.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生分享家庭传统和经历，从而促进文化理解。

tip: cultural指文化相关；cultured形容人有修养。

senses.en: no longer fresh, or no longer modern

ex.en: The milk is out of date; don't drink it.
ex.zh: 牛奶过期了，别喝。

ex.en: This old phone is out of date now.
ex.zh: 这部旧手机现在过时了。

tip: out of date 是“过期/过时”；up to date 是“最新”。
scene: An open fridge with an old milk carton and an expiry date.

senses.en: Agree to receive something or say yes to an offer
Recognize that something is true or valid
Take responsibility or stop resisting an unpleasant situation

ex.en: I gladly accepted her invitation to dinner on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我欣然接受了她周六共进晚餐的邀请。

ex.en: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
ex.zh: 政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。

tip: 接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。

senses.en: in or to a foreign country

ex.en: My sister moved abroad and now lives near the sea.
ex.zh: 我姐姐移居国外，现在住在海边。

ex.en: Studying abroad can help students develop independence and gain a better understanding of other cultures.
ex.zh: 出国留学能帮助学生培养独立性，并更好地理解其他文化。

tip: abroad是副词：说go abroad，不说go to abroad。

senses.en: Located in, coming from, or relating to the south.

ex.en: We spent a week exploring the island's southern coast.
ex.zh: 我们花了一周探索这座岛的南部海岸。

ex.en: Southern regions of the country may face longer droughts as rising temperatures increase pressure on water supplies.
ex.zh: 随着气温升高加大供水压力，该国南部地区可能面临更持久的干旱。

tip: south中/ou/读/aʊ/，southern中的元音读/ʌ/。

senses.en: To obtain something useful or increase in amount.
An increase in something or a benefit received.

ex.en: You will gain confidence after a few lessons.
ex.zh: 上几节课后，你就会更有信心。

ex.en: Students can gain valuable practical experience by volunteering for projects that benefit their local communities.
ex.zh: 学生可以通过志愿参与有益于当地社区的项目，获得宝贵的实践经验。

col: gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会
tip: gain常接经验、信心等；赢比赛通常用win。

senses.en: to go to an event or regularly visit an institution
to deal with something or care for someone

ex.en: My sister attends a dance class every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每周六上午都去上舞蹈课。

ex.en: Students who attend lectures regularly are more likely to understand difficult concepts and complete assignments successfully.
ex.zh: 经常听课的学生更有可能理解难懂的概念并顺利完成作业。

col: attend to a problem｜处理问题
tip: 参加活动直接接宾语；处理、照料用attend to。

senses.en: the physical parts of a computer or electronic system
tools and metal goods used for building and household repairs

ex.en: The technician replaced some old hardware inside my computer.
ex.zh: 技术员更换了我电脑里的一些旧硬件。

ex.en: Schools need reliable hardware and regular technical support to make digital learning accessible to all students.
ex.zh: 学校需要可靠的硬件和定期的技术支持，让所有学生都能参与数字化学习。

tip: 不可数名词；hardware指硬件，software指软件。
